about: Every card verktyg/kort.py saw come to rest on the table, per stretch (its start in seconds) and id. from is sko when the card was seen leaving the shoe's mouth (as a card on the felt, or as card colour at the mouth in the 3 s before it showed up), unseen when not. left and landed are seconds of the film (left: the card is out of the mouth; landed: it first lies still); duration is landed - left. to is where it first lay still (place: dealer or seat 1-7, seat 1 at the picture's left; px in the table picture, m on the felt). turned is true when it was seen back up first (at the mouth or on the felt) and face up later; turnWindow the seconds between the last back and the first face seen. collected is when it was taken away (null when the stretch ended first). Stretches the cards were already lying in when they began give cards that landed at the stretch's first second without a left.
